name: Barcelona

portalsFound.observation: Spanish Direccion General del Catastro INSPIRE page lists WFS endpoints http://ovc.catastro.meh.es/INSPIRE/wfsCP.aspx (cadastral parcels), wfsBU, wfsAD, plus a WMS. National service (Basque Country and Navarra publish their own cadastres separately).

Barcelona open data CKAN: dataset 'mapa-parcelari' (Land plots in the city of Barcelona), licence CC-BY-4.0; resources are a WMS reference and 20-34 MB SHP/DGN bulk downloads, not a bounded query, so not fetched.
Catastro WMS capabilities (raster maps only); abstract says free use, no mass download of cartography permitted.
